nodes.title: Route tool suggestion requests to the API server instead of the frontend origin
nodes.summary: The POST to /api/tool-suggestions returns 404 because src/lib/tools/toolSuggestionsClient.ts passes the relative path /api/tool-suggestions straight to fetch(). In the deployed app that resolves to pened-creator.fly.dev, the frontend host, which has no such route, so the request never reaches pened-server. Export a small apiUrl(path) helper from src/lib/curriculum/shared/apiClient.ts that reuses the existing validated VITE_API_URL base URL (buildUrl). Make the real adapter call fetch(apiUrl(TOOL_SUGGESTIONS_PATH)), keeping credentials: "include". Update toolSuggestionsClient.test.ts, which currently asserts the relative URL, to expect the full API URL. Then redeploy the frontend and confirm a suggestion submits with a 201 from the deployed app. Also confirm CORS_ORIGIN on pened-server includes https://pened-creator.fly.dev.

nodes.title: Define and validate the saved slideshow data model
nodes.summary: Establish a clear, typed schema for the slide objects the AI returns in 'Step 2 — Paste the AI's response' and ensure parsing, validation, and error handling are reliable once the data is saved. The new per-slide view depends on this data being consistently structured, so this groundwork prevents rendering failures and ambiguous states.

nodes.title: Fix SlideDataViewer 'keeps the index in range when the deck shrinks' regression
nodes.summary: The test navigates to slide 3, then rerenders with a 2-slide deck and expects to land on slide 2. It now shows slide 1 instead. The cause is the content-signature reset added to SlideDataViewer: any change in deck content, including a shrink, resets the index to 0, which contradicts the clamp-on-shrink behavior. Decide the intended behavior. Changed content resets to the first slide (the newer, documented behavior) and shrink-clamping only applies when the content signature is unchanged, which effectively never happens. So update the test to expect a reset to slide 1, and keep the separate clampSlideIndex safeguard covered by a test that forces an out-of-range index (for example via initialIndex). Then align the README wording so the two behaviors are not described as both applying to a shrinking deck.

nodes.title: Build the per-slide 'add images' prompt builder
nodes.summary: Add a pure, tested prompt-builder module in the phase2-content lib folder that takes one slide's data object plus the descriptions of the images already uploaded for the lesson (from the lesson's imagePrompts and images, using each item's id, description, altText and uploaded filename) and returns a prompt asking an AI to add image elements to that slide. The prompt should embed the slide JSON, list the available images by id and description, restate the relevant slide and image-element schema rules (type 'image', a real src taken only from the uploaded images, position, size) so the response stays compatible with slideshowDeckValidator, and specify a JSON-only response format. It must handle a lesson with no uploaded images and slides that already contain image elements. No saving or parsing of the AI's response is included in this update.

nodes.title: Fix the ambiguous text query in the SlideImagesPromptModal 'labelled dialog' test
nodes.summary: In SlideImagesPromptModal.test.tsx, 'renders a labelled dialog with a title and description' fails because within(dialog).getByText(/Cell walls/) matches two elements: the description paragraph and the prompt textarea, whose text contains the slide JSON. The modal is behaving correctly; the query is too loose. Scope the assertion to the description element, for example by checking that the dialog's accessible description includes the slide title, or by using the description element's id or a more specific matcher. The textarea's contents are already covered by other tests. Make sure no other assertion in the file relies on a bare getByText that could also match the textarea. Then run the file repeatedly to confirm it passes consistently, and confirm the full npm run test reports all 206 tests passing.

nodes.title: Build the pure logic to parse, validate and apply an AI's updated slide
nodes.summary: Add a tested module in the phase2-content lib folder that takes the text pasted from the AI (which may include code fences or stray prose) and the original slide and returns a discriminated result: the validated updated slide, or a list of per-field errors. It should reuse the existing parser and validator from slideshowDeckValidator rather than adding a second set of rules. It should also check the rules the 'Add images' prompt promises: the slide id is unchanged, every original element is still present and unmodified, the only additions are elements of type 'image', each new image's src is exactly one of the lesson's uploaded image srcs (so the AI cannot invent files), and new element ids are unique. Add a pure helper that returns a new deck with the slide at a given index replaced, without mutating the input and keeping every other slide, deck field and metadata untouched. Cover valid responses, fenced or prose-wrapped JSON, malformed JSON, a wrapper object around the slide, removed or edited existing elements, invented src values, duplicate ids, a response with no new images, and the no-uploaded-images case. This goal changes no UI.

nodes.title: Prevent API calls that bypass the shared API client
nodes.summary: The suggestions client reached production with a relative URL because it calls fetch() directly instead of going through apiClient.ts, and the mock adapter and the unit test hid the problem. Add a guard so this cannot recur: either a check in scripts/ (run in verify.yml alongside check-folder-boundaries.js) or an ESLint rule that fails on any fetch() to a path starting with /api/ outside apiClient.ts and authClient.ts. Add a test that the real suggestions adapter builds its URL from VITE_API_URL. Document in the tools README that all API calls must use the shared client so the base URL, credentials and error handling stay in one place.

nodes.summary: Add a new step after 'Step 2 — Paste the AI's response' in Content Generation Phase 2 (following the 'Images generated' step 7 context) that shows each slide's data object in its own card. Include a breadcrumb-style Next/Previous navigation component so users can move through slides one at a time, with clear indication of current position and disabled states at the first and last slide.

nodes.title: Fix ToolSuggestionModal focus-return-on-close test failure
nodes.summary: In ToolSuggestionModal.test.tsx, 'returns focus to the element that opened the dialog after closing' fails because focus ends on document.body instead of the opener button after Escape. This failure is in code untouched by the Slide Data work, so first confirm whether it is pre-existing or flaky (the file is the slowest, at about 6.4s, and other tests in it use timers). Investigate whether the dialog primitive's focus restore runs after unmount or is affected by the auto-close timer or fake timers, and whether the opener is focused before the dialog opens in the test. Fix either the modal (explicitly restore focus to the trigger on close) or the test setup (focus the opener before opening, and wait for the restore), and make sure it passes reliably across repeated runs.

nodes.title: Add the per-slide 'Add images' button and prompt modal to SlideDataViewer
nodes.summary: Add a button to the card that shows an individual slide's data in the SlideDataViewer step. Clicking it opens a modal that displays the generated prompt for the current slide, with copy (and optionally download) actions and a read-only view, following the patterns of PromptViewer and ToolSuggestionModal. Pass the lesson record (or its image descriptions) from the lesson route into SlideDataViewer, keep the modal in sync with the slide currently shown, and handle the case where no images have been uploaded with a clear message. Include accessible labelling, keyboard and focus handling (focus returns to the button on close), and component tests. Nothing happens after the prompt is displayed.

nodes.title: Make Vitest exit cleanly by removing the app's server plugins from the test config
nodes.summary: npm run test passes but still prints 'close timed out after 5000ms: Tests closed successfully but something prevents Vite server from exiting'. The earlier cleanup of test timers, mocks and subscriptions and the shorter teardownTimeout did not fix it, so the cause is probably not in the tests. The strongest suspect is vite.config.ts, which vitest also loads: it registers the tanstackStart and nitro plugins, which are meant for the dev server and build and can hold handles open, plus the file-based router watcher. Run npm run test:hanging (the hanging-process reporter) to confirm the open handle. Then give Vitest its own config, for example vitest.config.ts that merges only what tests need (the jsdom environment, the '@' alias, the React plugin, the setup file and the include pattern) and leaves out tanstackStart, nitro and the tailwind plugin, or otherwise disable those plugins when process.env.VITEST is set. Keep vite.config.ts unchanged for dev and build. Confirm that npm run test and npm run verify finish promptly with no close-timeout message across repeated runs, that typecheck and lint still cover the new config file, and that the routeTree.gen.ts codegen is not needed by any test.

nodes.title: Save an updated slide to the deck and refresh the lesson without losing the user's place
nodes.summary: Wire persistence for the updated slide. Use the existing saveSlideshowDeck path, which re-validates the deck before saving and stores it as the lesson's slideshow interactiveContent entry, so a saved deck still cannot be rejected by pened-tools. Add an onSlideUpdated (or similar) callback to SlideDataViewer that receives the new deck, and have lessons.$lessonId.tsx save it, update lessonRecord with the server's result and surface save failures (expired session, oversized deck, network error) separately from validation errors. Fix the interaction with the deck-signature reset: SlideDataViewer currently returns to slide 1 and closes the modal whenever the deck content changes, and the route bumps slideDataResetKey when the deck is re-saved. A slide update made from the viewer itself must keep the user on the slide they just edited, so distinguish that case from a deck replaced in the Generate Slideshow Data step, which should still reset. Cover this with tests, including that a re-saved deck from the other step still resets, and that the saved deck contains exactly one slideshow entry.

nodes.title: Align the frontend suggestions client with the new server contract
nodes.summary: The server work now adds GET /api/tool-suggestions/mine for any signed-in user, keeps the list, get and PATCH endpoints admin-only, and returns structured 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED and 404 NOT_FOUND errors. Add METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED to ToolSuggestionErrorCode in toolSuggestionsClient.ts. Add a listMyToolSuggestions() adapter method for /mine, with a matching mock. Update docs/api-handoff/tool-suggestions.md. Make sure the UI never calls the admin-only list endpoint for users whose isAdmin is false, using isAdmin from the auth context.

nodes.title: Stabilize the test run so Vitest exits cleanly
nodes.summary: After the run, Vitest reports 'close timed out after 10000ms' because something keeps the Vite server from exiting. Use the hanging-process reporter to identify the open handle. Likely suspects are the ToolSuggestionModal auto-close and mock adapter timers, or unmocked network and subscription listeners in GlobalToolbar tests. Clean up timers and subscriptions in afterEach, then confirm that npm run test and npm run verify finish promptly and consistently.

nodes.title: Document the feature and extend QA coverage
nodes.summary: Update the phase2-content component and lib READMEs to describe the new prompt builder, the modal, and the new props on SlideDataViewer. Add items to the end-to-end regression checklist for opening the modal from each slide, verifying the prompt contains that slide's data and the uploaded image descriptions, the no-images state, copy behavior, and keyboard and screen-reader behavior. Note that saving the AI's response is deliberately deferred to a later update.

nodes.title: Add the 'paste the AI's response' area to the Add images modal
nodes.summary: Under the prompt in SlideImagesPromptModal, add a labelled textarea where the user pastes the AI's response, with an 'Apply to slide' button. On apply, run the parse and validate logic and, if it passes, call the save callback. Show validation problems as a list of field paths in an alert (using formatDeckErrors style output) and keep the pasted text so the user can fix and retry. Show a distinct message for a failed save. While saving, disable the button and the textarea and prevent the modal from being dismissed, like ToolSuggestionModal does, and after a successful save show a success toast and close the modal, returning focus to the 'Add images' button. Decide how the modal behaves with no uploaded images: the paste area should be disabled or hidden, since there is nothing to apply. Clear the pasted text and any errors when the modal closes or the slide changes. Keep the read-only prompt, copy and download actions as they are. Accessibility: label the textarea, link errors with aria-describedby and role='alert', and move focus to the textarea or the error sensibly. Update SlideImagesPromptModal.test.tsx and the 'Add images' section of SlideDataViewer.test.tsx to cover a successful apply, each kind of validation error, a save failure, the saving state, and that the updated slide's images then show in the card.

nodes.title: Document the save flow and extend QA coverage
nodes.summary: Update the phase2-content component README and lib README to describe the new parse and validate module, the slide-replacement helper, the onSlideUpdated wiring and how the viewer keeps its position after a save. Remove the notes saying that saving the AI's response is deliberately deferred. Update docs/qa/end-to-end-regression-checklist.md, replacing its 'nothing is saved' statements in the Add images section, with items for: pasting a valid response and seeing the image elements appear on that slide, staying on the same slide after saving, a reload showing the saved change, the deck still opening in pened-tools, the slideshow entry count staying at one, invalid JSON, an invented src, removed or edited existing elements, a failed save, and keyboard and screen-reader behavior of the new textarea and error messages.
